profile.a: The author, presenting an individual Lean Six Sigma project (MBA36A).
The JBS Centre for Endowment Asset Management (CEAM): its director and the research students who analyse foreign exchange data.
A research-grade platform in Python and R-Shiny to clean, analyse and visualise foreign exchange spot prices.
Summer 2025, with a 15-week build in three phases.
Cambridge Judge Business School, using data from Bloomberg, Reuters and internal systems.
The centre received several terabytes of trading data that existing tools could not visualise or aggregate, and researchers spent most of their 33 analytical hours a week on method and cleaning.
DMADV: voice of the customer (define), Gage R&R and time study (measure), root cause analysis (analyse), design of experiments (design), control charts and accuracy standards (verify).

charts.title: Current validation methods: how often used vs how effective (%)
charts.takeaway: The most-used check (visual inspection) is less effective than statistical review. The platform's built-in statistical and outlier checks target exactly this gap.

charts.title: Where researchers' time goes (% as reported)
charts.takeaway: Most effort goes into working out method and cleaning rather than research. Note that the shares as printed add to 128%, so they need correcting before they can be used as a baseline.

charts.title: Accuracy standards set for the platform vs the industry benchmark (%)
charts.takeaway: Every standard sits above the 99.0% benchmark. This is what the '100% accuracy requirement' means in practice: tolerances of 0.1 to 0.5 percentage points.

items.title: Define: voice of the customer
items.text: Interviews with CEAM research students set requirements: clean data with transparent outlier removal, flexible filters, heatmaps, export to Python and MATLAB.

items.title: Measure: Gage R&R and time study
items.text: 10 parts, 3 operators, 3 measurements; 33 analytical hours a week mapped; data 99.2% complete with 2.3% outliers.

items.title: Analyse: root causes
items.text: Five whys and a fishbone point to missing visualisation, poor data aggregation and a monolithic architecture.

items.title: Design: experiments
items.text: Tests frequency settings, outlier thresholds and chart parameters to choose the platform configuration.

items.title: Verify: control charts
items.text: Track dashboard complexity and time to insight; accuracy standards of 99.5-99.9%.

charts.title: Root causes and the fix for each

items.title: Poor data aggregation
items.text: Fix: chunked data processing to manage memory.
